name: page-quotes
note: Curly quotes, a straight apostrophe and an ampersand in the *title* and *subtitle*, which reach three different escaping paths in `generate_metadata` (core.py:697-705). `title` is minimal-escaped, so its quotes and apostrophes survive bare. `subtitle` is full-escaped, so `'` becomes `&#39` — with no semicolon, which is the quirk. And `description` escapes the *already-escaped* subtitle, so that `&#39` becomes `&#39`; the escaping is not idempotent and the second pass is the one that proves the first ran. `quote_symbol` normalises the curly forms first, so `’` and `‘` arrive at the escaper as `'`.

previewContent.subtitle: It’s a ‘short’ note — with an "ampersand" & a "quote"
